## [I purchased a painting](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/677d6837dca976dd243dfebf)
I purchased a painting. In the description it says the painting will take time as they are custom made by the artist. We waited 4 weeks and when it arrives there was no signature by the artist which puzzled me. I wrote to the company and expressed my concern. One week later they wrote that it is a copy of the painting. It was 2600.00! I now am asking what they are going to do about it - it was a gift. Still no answer. Basically they are counterfeit and I am reporting the company to the police because they keep stringing me along. Stay away. I will write back to this review if I hear from them. 

I received a response from you and submitted the order number. I don’t understand why you seem so shocked over my review. I have been dealing with Mico from your company and he said he escalated it. I have not heard a word for resolution.

December 9, 2024

Unprompted review

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jan 8, 2025

Hi Charl,

We're grateful you've brought this issue to our attention. It must have been surprising to receive a painting that lacked the artist's signature. Given that our artworks are custom-made, they're not always produced by the originating artist, yet they are meticulously crafted with the same quality materials. A request has been made via Trustpilot to obtain additional details, which will aid our Customer Experience team in swiftly resolving your concern. Your patience and comprehension during this process are deeply valued.

Should you need any more information or assistance, please feel free to reach out.
